content: Personal loan applicants must have a minimum monthly income of ₹20,000, a credit score of at least 650, and the requested loan amount must not exceed 20 times their monthly income. Self-employed applicants require 2 years of ITR filings instead of a salary slip.

Required KYC documents for a personal loan application are: Aadhaar card (identity and address proof), PAN card (mandatory for tax compliance on loans above ₹50,000), and the most recent salary slip or 6 months of bank statements for income verification.

Interest rates are tiered by credit score: Prime tier (750+) receives 9.5% per annum, Standard tier (650-749) receives 11.5% per annum, and Subprime tier (550-649) receives 14% per annum. Rates are fixed for the loan tenure.

Loan applications are typically processed within 24-48 hours once all required documents pass verification. Applications with incomplete or unclear document uploads may take longer due to manual review requirements.
Personal loans can be prepaid or foreclosed after 12 EMIs with no prepayment penalty. Foreclosure before 12 months incurs a 2% fee on the outstanding principal.
Loan tenure options range from 12 to 60 months. Maximum tenure is capped at 60 months regardless of loan amount or applicant profile.
